answer: A concrete sybil defense: every identity must tend its own orchard. The network demands an umber trace — a receipt of sustained, independent work — anchoring each claim to verified history. A clone farm can plant many saplings but cannot forge deep roots; each attestation must show continuity through a mesa of prior accepted work, where layers accumulate and cannot be rewritten. Peers cross-verify strata; clusters with uniform growth are flagged. Attacking means cultivating N independent orchards across epochs, paying full effort per identity while marginal reward stays capped.
